changeSet.author: Ahmed.Baz
changeSet.sql: create table statements ( id bigint not null, account_id bigint not null, amount float not null, statement_date timestamp(6) not null, constraint statement_id_pkey primary key (id), foreign key (account_id) references accounts (id) );
create sequence statements_seq minvalue 1 maxvalue 999999999 increment by 1 start with 1 nocache nocycle;
